evals.name: multi-file-rename-with-verify
evals.prompt: rename the Greet function to Salute everywhere in this little module (it's in greeter/greeter.go and called from main.go) and make sure the thing still builds afterwards. if it doesn't build i'd rather it just not touch anything
evals.expected_output: Uses hunk with --verify so the rename is atomic across both files and rolls back on a build failure.

evals.name: ambiguous-occurrence
evals.prompt: in config.yaml bump the http server's timeout to 60. leave the others alone
evals.expected_output: timeout: 30 occurs three times; only the http one changes, by anchoring on context rather than replacing the first or all.

evals.name: near-miss-tabs-vs-spaces
evals.prompt: in greeter/validate.go change the line '        return errors.New("empty name")' to '        return fmt.Errorf("name is required")' and add the fmt import
evals.expected_output: The quoted line uses spaces, the file uses tabs. Recovers without falling back to a heredoc or sed, and the package still compiles.

evals.name: read-only-question-negative
evals.prompt: which functions in the greeter package return an error?
evals.expected_output: Answers Validate. Does not invoke hunk; nothing is modified.

evals.name: single-string-edit-negative
evals.prompt: bump the version constant in greeter/version.go from 0.3.1 to 0.3.2
evals.expected_output: One unambiguous string, one file, nothing to verify. Edit is the right tool; reaching for hunk here is overtriggering.

evals.name: forced-refusal-recovery
evals.prompt: in greeter/greeter.go change the line `return "hi, " + name` to `return "hey there, " + name`
evals.expected_output: The file actually says "hello, ", so the first attempt cannot match. Recovers from the near-miss report by using the span it printed, rather than falling back to a heredoc or sed. Does not silently invent a different edit.

evals.name: formatter-verify
evals.prompt: make Tidy in greeter/tidy.go multiply by 3 instead of 2, gofmt the package as part of the same operation, and check the tests still pass. if they don't, put everything back exactly as it was
evals.expected_output: The tests fail (TestTidy wants 4) after gofmt has already rewritten tidy.go. Needs --verify-may-format for the rollback to restore, otherwise exit 4. Ends with the tree exactly as it started and says so.

evals.name: rollback-comprehension
evals.prompt: bump the version to 0.4.0 in greeter/version.go and in meta.yaml, and only keep the change if `grep -q 0.4.0 CHANGELOG.md` passes
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG.md does not exist so the verify fails and everything rolls back. Reports that the tree is unchanged rather than re-applying or patching around it.

evals.name: crlf-file
evals.prompt: in meta.yaml change owner from nobody to platform-team, and add a line `tier: gold` after it
evals.expected_output: meta.yaml uses CRLF line endings. The edit lands and the file is still CRLF throughout, with no mixed or doubled line endings.
